Failure Monitor 1.0.0 - Automated cron job failure detection & self-healing

- Initial release with automated failure monitoring for cron jobs.
- Supports real-time error detection, diagnosis, and reporting.
- Provides auto-repair for common issues (timeouts, config, permissions) without human intervention.
- Requests user confirmation for more complex failures (API key, script errors, external issues).
- Sends detailed push notifications and keeps complete logs of all actions.
